context_draw_random_state: NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence([20261030, split_code, draw_index])). split_code=0 fit,1 development.
training_order: NumPy default_rng(20261031), repeat fresh permutation of 128 fitting draw rows, partition each into 32 batches of 4, retain first 400 batches. Thus 12 full epochs and 16 batches of next epoch. Same order in both arms.
label_storage: Separate scalar int64 NPY files, read only by caller. Observation NPZ never contains labels.
device: CPU only,2 torch main threads and2 spawn DataLoader workers per independent arm. Each preparation worker uses1 torch thread.
checkpoint_rule: Initialize identical model state from seed 101. Evaluate before and after 400 updates. Final checkpoint only. No development selection or early stopping.
diagnostic_limits: 128 fitting draws and64 development draws are not a final ancestry benchmark.
Complete native trees and their SNP pools can extend outside the 50 kb coordinate neighborhood.
no_cross matched packet still first-sweeps context trees, its timing is not optimized one-tree baseline latency.
Geometric kernel arithmetic is double precision, learned tensors and optimizer are FP32.
